::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Linearized Amplifier Technologies and Services, formed in Dec 2017 by IIT Roorkee faculty and students (founding director Prof. Karun Rawat) and incubated at iHUB DivyaSampark. Lists a 13-17 GHz 8-bit phase-shifter chip in TSMC 65nm bulk CMOS (1 x 1.38 mm die) and a radar front-end chip, plus GaN-on-SiC MMIC power amplifiers and modules. Won first prize (start-up category) in DRDO's Dare to Dream 4.0 in 2024 for a gunshot-detection system, a non-chip product.
:::

## What does this firm design?

RF front-end chips (phase shifters, radar front-ends, CMOS/BiCMOS RFIC IP), GaN MMICs and power-amplifier modules.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 4/5:** Domain difficulty 4: Ku-band CMOS phase shifters, radar front-ends and GaN MMIC PAs.
- **IP ownership 4/5:** IP ownership 4: own RFIC designs from an IIT Roorkee RF research group; standard foundry processes.
- **Design completeness 3/5:** Design completeness 3: product page gives die size and specs for a TSMC 65nm chip; no independent tape-out report.
- **Market readiness 2/5:** Market readiness 2: quote-on-request products and modules; no named customers or volume sales.
